The Lakers without Luka Dončić on the floor defeat the shorthanded Clippers 103-87 and move to 4-1 on the young season.

Quentin Grimes had 22 pts, while Colin Sexton had 21 pts.

Best rebounding effort this season by a longshot, outrebounding the Clippers 48-41.

F: Lakers 103, Clippers 87. That was about as putrid of an offensive display as you’re likely to see all season. Last time they shot this poorly (35.6%) with this many turnovers (24) was April 1999. Rude awakening: 11 players on the team weren’t even alive then. Clippers are 1-3.

Vando wound up playing WITH Kessler

Lakers call timeout with 3:25 left and leading 98-83

Timeout Lakers with 6:25, leading 94-76

#TeamBubbleWrap should be underway soon, but the Lakers have been known to rack up the minutes before letting their third string have too much potential impact on a game
